purpose: Complete OPFG World V1 curation proposal: 20 Locations per Blue plus expanded Paradise/New World/special regions.

worldV1.paradiseRoutePolicy: 7 authored Paradise routes with comparable main-route depth; route membership is OPFG-authored, not claimed as exhaustive canon.

notes: The original 8 Birth Locations per Blue are unchanged.
V3 promotes catalogue entries before adding custom Locations.
North Blue required one additional OPFG-original gap-fill location after the viable catalogue candidates were exhausted.
All promoted uncertain entries remain explicitly marked sourceType=uncertain.

P0_INGRESS.notes: Après Twin Capes, un Event de navigation propose l'une des sept routes OPFG.

P1_CLASSIC.notes: Route qui peut rappeler le parcours connu, conservée comme UNE route parmi sept, jamais la route par défaut.

P2_TRADE.notes: Route commerciale longue: ports, marchés, royaumes, industrie et chantiers. Sa densité est désormais comparable à P1 sans recopier son itinéraire.

P3_WILD.notes: Route longue centrée navigation, survie, reliefs, météo et îles peu urbanisées.

P4_KINGDOMS.notes: Route longue de royaumes et territoires politiques: diplomatie, réputation, tensions locales et commerce.

P5_OUTCASTS.notes: Route longue de communautés marginales, récupérateurs, contrebande, équipages sans pavillon et réseaux clandestins. Baltigo reste un embranchement révolutionnaire fortement conditionné.

P6_STRANGE.notes: Route longue volontairement bizarre et légère, conçue pour soutenir des batches très One Piece-like sans dépendre d'arcs manga.

P7_HAZARD.notes: Route longue de risques environnementaux et maritimes. La progression doit tester préparation, navire, navigation, crew et prise de risque plutôt que simplement infliger des dégâts.

integrationWarnings: This file is a curation layer, not a replacement for the 502-entry geographical working catalogue.
Entries marked uncertain_source or needs_type_review require the final canon/name verification pass before runtime integration.
OPFG custom routes are design-authored. Do not label their exact island sequence as canon.

Temporal access to Marineford, Mary Geoise, Baltigo, Punk Hazard, Wano, Totto Land, Hachinosu and other gated sites must be enforced by authored Events/Conditions, not by making them generic navigation targets.
Egghead remains reference-only in V1 by explicit design decision.
V2 deliberately expands Paradise scope: alternate routes are now similar in length to P1 and therefore require substantially more Event batches.
V3 increases the Blue runtime roster from 60 to 80 without increasing Birth Location counts.
Do not silently convert sourceType=uncertain Blue additions to canon.
Ironpine Mining Town is OPFG-original and exists specifically to prevent North Blue from remaining under-differentiated.
